source_metadata.notes: Official Comptroller resource developed with Outschool.org and Odyssey. Version indexes the stated program school year, not a publisher revision. This is a rolling listing snapshot; upstream as-of, publication/revision dates and dataset reuse license are not supplied. Private School and EFA-Eligible tags require validation. Listings include pre-K and online providers and do not establish one record per physical campus, approval dates, student enrollment, payments, governing districts, or continuity with legacy IDs. This directory has no student-count measures; suppression documents for separate participant-count publications do not apply to these roster fields.
